correctness.rationale: Equal-count, hence equal-length, words yield disjoint cylinder pieces with common scale 1/(2^m 3^n) and mass M=p^m(1-p)^n; prefixing proves the offset recurrence. For a hypothesized orthonormal exponential basis translated to contain zero, Parseval for the normalized cylinder indicators gives a circle probability with the asserted difference moments zero and mass at least M at 1. Integrating the nonnegative squared Dirichlet polynomial gives (L+1)M<=1 for a complete difference interval [-L,L]. The independent exact reproduction check_certificates.py, not the frozen script, recovers for (9,9) and (11,5) the cardinalities 48620 and 4368, maxima 5028751 and 247687, and first gaps 3163277 and 92381; all rational signs at the two brackets and 2/3 were checked. The first mass polynomial exceeds one on (alpha,2/3] and the second on [2/3,beta), proving the open interval, strictly larger than the previous closed interval. Read VERIFICATION.md and verify_differences.py without executing the uploaded script. The claim is scoped to the open interval and is not an assertion of endpoint optimality: in fact 195913-11151=2*92381 in A_(11,5)-A_(11,5), so equality at beta would force sigma onto the 92381st roots of unity by equality in the Dirichlet-polynomial bound, contradicting the zero moment at twice 92381. This optional endpoint strengthening does not enter the stated theorem.
